Yuki Tanaka  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972 54 123 4567 | yuki.tanaka@nexaflo.com | linkedin.com/in/yukitanaka | github.com/yukitanaka  

A seasoned frontend architect with 9 years of delivering high-impact digital experiences across fast-paced startups and large-scale agencies. Specializing in building scalable, performant, and accessible web applications that drive business growth. Proven expertise in leading frontend teams, architecting complex systems, and mentoring engineers to elevate technical standards. Known for driving innovation through design systems, performance optimization, and seamless integration with backend ecosystems.  

Senior Frontend Engineer at NexaFlow Technologies (2023–Present)  
Led the frontend architecture for NexaFlow’s flagship platform, a real-time analytics dashboard used by 300+ enterprises. Spearheaded the migration from legacy React components to a unified Next.js monorepo, reducing bundle sizes by 40% and improving LCP by 35%. Designed and maintained a comprehensive design system adopted across 5 product lines, ensuring consistency and accelerating UI development by 25%. Instrumented performance monitoring tools to identify and resolve critical bottlenecks, resulting in a 20% increase in user retention. Collaborated closely with backend teams to refine REST API endpoints, reducing API call latency by 15% through caching strategies and payload optimization.  

Lead Frontend Engineer at FinPro Systems (2021–2023)  
Architected the frontend infrastructure for FinPro’s financial analytics suite, supporting 100,000+ active users. Introduced TypeScript across the codebase, reducing runtime errors by 60% and improving code maintainability. Engineered a state management solution using Redux and Zustand, enabling cross-team collaboration and reducing component duplication by 40%. Spearheaded the implementation of responsive design principles, ensuring seamless user experiences across desktop, tablet, and mobile interfaces.  

Senior Frontend Engineer at CloudFlow Inc. (2018–2021)  
Played a pivotal role in scaling the frontend stack for CloudFlow’s SaaS platform, handling 500,000+ monthly active users. Built and maintained a reusable component library that cut development time for new features by 30%. Designed and executed performance optimization strategies, including lazy loading and code splitting, which improved page load times by 25%.  

Frontend Developer at InnovateTech Solutions (2015–2018)  
Contributed to the development of a B2B SaaS product, focusing on modular, maintainable frontend architecture. Pioneered the use of Node.js for server-side rendering, enhancing SEO and performance for enterprise clients.  

Technical Skills  
JavaScript: Architecting large-scale applications, mentoring junior engineers, and implementing robust type systems.  
React: Driving component-based architecture, optimizing rendering performance, and ensuring cross-browser compatibility.  
TypeScript: Enforcing type safety across monorepos, reducing bugs, and improving developer productivity.  
State Management (Redux/Zustand): Central to application architecture, enabling scalable state handling and team collaboration.  
Design Systems: Building and maintaining cross-team design frameworks, ensuring consistency across 5+ product lines.  
Responsive Design: Crafting adaptive UIs for diverse devices, increasing user engagement by 15% in key markets.  
Web Performance Optimization: Implementing strategies to reduce load times, improve LCP, and enhance user retention.  
REST API Design: Collaborating with backend teams to refine endpoints, reducing latency and improving data throughput.  
Test Automation: Establishing CI/CD pipelines with Jest and Cypress, ensuring 95%+ test coverage for mission-critical features.  
Next.js: Leading full-stack migrations, leveraging server components and static generation for high-performance apps.  
Node.js: Integrating with backend services, building reusable utilities, and optimizing API interactions.  
Selenium/Playwright: Automating end-to-end tests for complex workflows, ensuring reliability across browser environments.  
Unit Testing: Writing comprehensive test suites to validate core functionality and prevent regressions.  

Projects  
- **NexaFlow Analytics Dashboard**: Redesigned frontend architecture using Next.js and TypeScript, achieving 40% faster load times and 35% improved LCP.  
- **FinPro Financial Suite**: Implemented a reusable component library, reducing development time by 30% and improving code quality.  
- **CloudFlow SaaS Platform**: Optimized performance through lazy loading and code splitting, cutting page load times by 25%.  

Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Tokyo Institute of Technology (2015)  

Certifications  
- Certified React Developer (2022)  
- Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect (2021)
